title: Turkey, ground, 93% lean, 7% fat, pan‑broiled crumbles

content.title: About
content.content: Ground turkey is finely minced turkey meat containing 93 % lean meat and 7 % fat. It is pan‑broiled, which locks in moisture while giving a light, savory flavor. The product is versatile for dishes such as pasta sauces, tacos, and stir‑fries.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey is one of the leanest poultry meats, making it popular in low‑fat diets.
Ground turkey cooks faster than beef, reducing overall cooking time.
Pan‑broiling quickly sears the meat, preserving its natural juices.
Turkey is a good source of tryptophan, an amino acid that supports serotonin production.
In the United States, turkey is traditionally associated with Thanksgiving, but it is enjoyed year‑round.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: The 93 % lean content provides a substantial amount of complete protein for muscle maintenance and repair.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Only 7 % fat makes it suitable for calorie‑controlled and heart‑healthy eating plans.

items.title: Rich in vitamin B12
items.content: Vitamin B12 supports nerve function and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Contains zinc and iron
items.content: These minerals are essential for immune health and oxygen transport.

items.title: Very low carbohydrate
items.content: Ground turkey is virtually carb‑free, fitting well into low‑carb diets.

items.title: Food‑borne illness risk
items.content: As with any meat, ground turkey can harbor pathogens; it must be stored and cooked to safe temperatures.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to turkey meat.

items.title: Sodium content in seasoned versions
items.content: Pre‑seasoned crumbles may contain added salt; check the label if you monitor sodium intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook the crumbles in a skillet, add them to sauces, use as a filling for tacos, burritos, or stuffed peppers, or form into patties and bake. Ensure the internal temperature reaches 165 °F (74 °C).

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at +4 °C for up to 2 days. For longer storage, freeze at -18 °C for up to 3 months. Thaw in the refrigerator, not at room temperature.
